title: Simulation-trained deep learning detected mucus plugs on non-contrast CT
summary: Using simulated training data without manually annotated training images, nnU-Net detected and segmented airway mucus plugs on non-contrast CT. Detection sensitivity was 0.837 (95% CI 0.818–0.854) on a test set of 98 plug-positive scans. The study does not establish prospective clinical benefit, multisite transportability or improved patient outcomes.
organization: University of Pennsylvania; Dokuz Eylül University; University of Pittsburgh; Wake Forest University
